messages:
deploy-bot: initiating catalog.enable for model harbor-13b variant quant-v2

Emma: scheduling a quiet cutover at 22:00 UTC. quick pre-shift checks?

Raj: fallback ladder needed. my suggestion: quant-v1 -> fp16 -> small-lex

Leah: agree on pinning existing prod traffic during cutover. propose pin_ttl=2h

Mike: also add a latency guard: if p95 > 600ms for 5m auto-drain quant-v2

ops-sre: alert rule created: catalog.rollout.latency_sustained > 600ms (5m) -> page #eng-oncall

Emma: deploy-bot what are batching + concurrency defaults for this variant? don't want TTI spikes

deploy-bot: batching.strategy=dynamic, max_batch_tokens=2048, concurrency=8

Raj: for safety, start concurrency=3 for first 10m then step to 6

Leah: adding rollback runbook snippet:

```
- triggers: p95 > 600ms for 5m OR errors > 1.5%
- action: pin to harbor-13b:quant-v1, notify #eng-releases, SRE oncall
- verification: check canary logs for OOMs/model-load failures
```

Mike: when pinning, set TTL=30m and drain incrementally to avoid mid-request drops

Emma: @Raj @Leah please confirm exact fallback order JSON for the runtime

Raj: committing fallback order:

["harbor-13b:quant-v2", "harbor-13b:quant-v1", "harbor-13b:fp16", "lexicon-6b:fp16"]

Leah: move lexicon to absolute last; prefer small-lex instead to limit cross-model blending

Raj: updated list:

["harbor-13b:quant-v2", "harbor-13b:quant-v1", "harbor-13b:fp16", "small-lex:fp16"]

deploy-bot: applied pin=harbor-13b:quant-v2@canary=12% -> ramp schedule step=10m

ops-sre: telemetry hooks set. watching traces and per-token cost for first 30m

Mike: abort if token cost > 20% without quality improvement

Emma: noted. release note draft: "harbor-13b quant-v2 enablement: canary 12% -> monitor latency/quality; fallback ladder set; pin TTL 2h"

Leah: posted evals: slight hallucination increase on long-context prompts (+0.6%). will post detailed diffs in 15m

Raj: safety flag: `--no-cross-variant-eviction` enabled to prevent cache churn during initial window

deploy-bot: canary to 12% succeeded at 22:10 UTC. no alerts so far

ops-sre: 5m p95=395ms, errors=0.12%, cost delta=+9% — within expectations

Mike: hold 12% for 20m then plan 25% -> 50% per ramp schedule if stable

Emma: keeping thread open. final check-in in ~45m or upon any rollback trigger

Leah: ack 👍

Raj: ack 👍

Mike: ack 👍
